fixture.title: HTML Toy 发布流程示例
fixture.local_build: The documented HTML template has no build step; site/ is the publishable directory. Both hosted workflow prechecks passed with a non-blocking unhashed JS/CSS filename warning.

v1.browser_check: Hosted preview rendered at desktop and phone width; bilingual copy and click counter worked.
v1.release_result: success; reused the preview artifact and package SHA, skipped rebuild, target=create, submitted for review

platform_read_only_observation.scope: One observation after first submission; no audit-pending or missing-URL state was observed.

v2.change: Two bilingual HTML paragraphs changed; no metadata or artwork change.
v2.browser_check: Hosted preview visibly showed new English and Mandarin copy at desktop and phone width.
v2.release_result: success; reused the preview artifact and package SHA, skipped rebuild, target=update, same Toy ID, submitted for review

guide_friction: The three public entry documents ask for a local static precheck but do not give a direct local command; the generated workflow ran its hosted precheck.

Authentication step 6 asks for a manual preview immediately after setting the Secret, before the new empty repository has a workflow; the first main-branch push produced and verified the preview instead.
limits: The two successful Release runs prove platform acceptance for review, not that v2 is live.
A missing-URL or audit-pending list response during an update was not reproduced.

guide_follow_up.auth_step_6: Current documentation now distinguishes first workflow push from manual preview of an existing workflow.
guide_follow_up.local_precheck: Current new-project guide now includes the copyable vendored doctor command.
guide_follow_up.runtime_change: None; documentation clarification after the beta.3 trial.
